title: The Limits of Closed-Form Couplings for Few-Step Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Few-step generators via flow models require complicated technical solutions such as a pretrained flow model or a consistency loss. While rectified flows have gained popularity for their success in few-step sampling, they pay a cost of needing a pre-trained model and sampling a large number of couplings per dataset. Yet for a finite dataset and a Gaussian probability path, the probability-flow vector field of the empirical distribution is available in closed form, so one could use this field as the teacher and skip pretraining altogether. We demonstrate that, surprisingly, this approach is impossible for problems of practical relevance. In particular, the analytic solution of the diffusion process in high dimensions becomes almost a linear transformation. translated_title: 少步生成中闭式耦合的局限性
translated_abstract: 基于流模型的少步生成器需要复杂的技术方案，例如预训练的流模型或一致性损失。尽管整流流因其在少步采样中的成功而广受欢迎，但其代价是需要一个预训练模型，并且需要为每个数据集采样大量的耦合。然而，对于有限数据集和高斯概率路径，经验分布的概率流向量场存在闭式解，因此人们可以将该场作为教师，完全跳过预训练。我们证明，令人惊讶的是，这种方法对于具有实际意义的问题是不可能实现的。特别地，高维空间中扩散过程的解析解几乎变成一个线性变换。积分的结果返回的是初始化时抽取的噪声向量，加上一个在经验上表现为数据点微弱副本的漂移项，且该漂移几乎与噪声无关。因此该耦合……
tldr: 研究发现高维情况下扩散过程的闭式解析解几乎退化为线性变换，因此无需预训练、直接利用闭式耦合进行少步生成的方法在实践中不可行。
en_tdlr: The closed-form analytic solution of the diffusion process in high dimensions degenerates into an almost linear transformation, making training-free few-step generation via closed-form couplings impossible for problems of practical relevance.
